rationale: Task T7 requires an early-warning model to predict high-cost claims at arrival. Split fraction 0.25 per objective. Target defined as paid_amount above 95th percentile using all_data to capture true population threshold. Features selected for availability at claim arrival: claim/service metadata, clinical indicators (diagnosis, place_of_service, length_of_stay, er/elective/preventive flags), billed and allowed amounts (available pre-payment), excluding paid_amount (prediction target) and high_cost_flag (target leakage). Standard scaling supports both logistic regression and random_forest. Retrieved synthetic_data skill applied to write_report caveats; denial rate skill not applicable.
